title: BiasTrace: Linking Reasoning Behaviours to Biased Outputs in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.14161v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs exhibit social biases that can produce inaccurate and discriminatory inferences, posing risks in high-stakes applications. While prior work has made progress in measuring and mitigating bias, it largely focuses on final outputs of models, with limited understanding of the mechanisms that produce biased outcomes. Recent advances in LLM reasoning offers a new lens for investigating bias, yet the link between reasoning and bias remains poorly understood. Existing approaches focus primarily on final answer correctness or explicitly biased language, overlooking different behaviours in reasoning that can drive biased outcomes. We introduce BiasTrace, an annotation scheme for labelling reasoning behaviours in model-generated traces and linking them to biased outcomes. translated_title: BiasTrace：将推理行为与大型语言模型中的偏见输出联系起来
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型表现出社会偏见，可能产生不准确和歧视性的推断，在高风险应用中构成风险。尽管先前工作在测量和缓解偏见方面取得了进展，但主要关注模型的最终输出，对产生偏见结果的机制理解有限。最近大型语言模型推理的进展为研究偏见提供了新视角，但推理与偏见之间的联系仍知之甚少。现有方法主要关注最终答案的正确性或明确的偏见语言，忽略了推理中可能驱动偏见结果的不同行为。我们引入了BiasTrace，一种用于标注模型生成轨迹中推理行为并将其与偏见结果联系起来的标注方案。BiasTrace捕获偏见特定行为（例如，不支持的群体假设）以及可能隐含地促成偏见的通用推理模式（例如，过度概括）。
tldr: BiasTrace提出了一种新的标注方案，通过系统性地分析模型推理轨迹中的偏见特定行为和通用推理模式，揭示了推理行为与偏见输出之间的因果联系，填补了现有研究仅关注最终输出而忽视推理机制的空白。
en_tdlr: BiasTrace introduces a novel annotation scheme that systematically links reasoning behaviors in LLM traces—including bias-specific actions and implicit patterns—to biased outputs, filling the gap in understanding the mechanisms behind bias beyond final outputs.
